attempts.rationale: The probe sets up an owner, a target user, and a private repository, grants the target read access, lets the target read the repository once (warming any per-session role cache), then uses A's DELETE /repos/:owner/:repo/collaborators/:username route to revoke the target, and finally asserts that the target's next read is denied. With A's per-request freshness the revocation is visible immediately, so the second read returns 404; with B's per-session cache the cached read role is still trusted, so the read succeeds and the assertion fails. If the revoke route is absent (base or B), the request falls through to Hono's default text/plain 404, which the probe reports as n/a.
